### A Simple Way to Think about Sanctification (1 Thessalonians 5:23) - Your Daily Bible Verse - July 18
Author: David Powlison
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/a-simple-way-to-think-about-sanctification-bible-study-minute-october-31-2017.html
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 5:23
Points:
- Sanctification represents the ongoing, practical process of maturing into true humanness.
- Vertically, it means growing increasingly childlike in trusting and walking with God our Father.
- Horizontally, it means becoming more like Christ by genuinely helping others in daily life and relationships.
- Sanctification operates across three biblical tenses: past standing as saints, present growth in holiness, and future perfection when seeing Christ face to face.

### What It Means to Be Anointed - Daily Hope with Rick Warren - August 6, 2026
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-august-6-2026.html
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 5:24
Points:
- God never assigns a task without providing the strength and resources needed to complete it.
- When a calling looks humanly impossible, God remains faithful to bring it to pass.
- The Spirit’s empowering presence helps believers endure hardships and overcome their own natural limitations.
- God equips and anoints believers so they can minister comfort and practical help to others.
- Spiritual empowerment cannot be stored up, requiring daily prayer for renewed strength and grace.
